excerpt.zh: [from.GetName]的大气主要由各种气态金属构成。进一步了解这颗行星的严苛条件后我们或许就能提取这些有价值的化合物。
excerpt.en: The atmosphere of [from.GetName] is primarily composed of various metals in a gaseous state. With better understanding of this planet's harsh conditions we may be able to extract these valuable compounds.

texts.zh: [from.GetName]的大气主要由各种气态金属构成。进一步了解这颗行星的严苛条件后我们或许就能提取这些有价值的化合物。
texts.en: The atmosphere of [from.GetName] is primarily composed of various metals in a gaseous state. With better understanding of this planet's harsh conditions we may be able to extract these valuable compounds.

sections.zh: [from.GetName]的大气主要由各种气态金属构成。进一步了解这颗行星的严苛条件后我们或许就能提取这些有价值的化合物。
sections.en: The atmosphere of [from.GetName] is primarily composed of various metals in a gaseous state. With better understanding of this planet's harsh conditions we may be able to extract these valuable compounds.

texts.zh:
[from.GetName]的异常大气捕获了大量的恒星辐射，导致行星暖化的连锁效应，甚至连金属都转化为高度活泼的气态形式存在。

这些化合物会与我们投放的所有调查设备瞬间发生反应，在表面附上一层结实的合金薄膜。而这一过程竟然不具有破坏性。

[leader.GetName]相信这一自然存在的蒸镀过程可以利用来提升[controller.GetName]内所有舰船船体的抗拉强度。
texts.en:
[from.GetName]'s unusual atmosphere has trapped vast amounts of solar radiation, causing a cascade of planetary warming such that metals exist in a gaseous and highly volatile state.

These compounds reacted instantly with any survey equipment we deployed, coating it in a thin but durable metallic alloy layer. Surprisingly, this process was non-destructive.

[leader.GetName] believes this naturally-occurring electroplating process could be harnessed to improve the tensile strength of ship hulls across the [controller.GetName].

texts.zh:
将物体送入[from.GetName]的气态金属大气中可以形成天然镀层。

这一独特的过程非常高效，通过进一步研究可以进行复现并用于改进[Root.Owner.GetName]所有舰船船体的耐用度。
texts.en:
Sending objects into the gaseous metal atmosphere of [from.GetName] results in a form of natural electroplating.

This unique process is remarkably effective and with further study could be replicated to improve ship hull durability across the [Root.Owner.GetName].

texts.zh:
我们已经找到工业规模复现[from.From.GetName]上活性大气的特殊蒸镀过程的方法。

利用我们学到的知识，[Root.Owner.GetEngineerPlural]们就能大幅提高特定金属的耐用性而不需要牺牲韧性或增加重量。

这些先进的方法可以应用到我们的舰船建造流程中。
texts.en:
We have found a way to replicate the unusual electroplating process of [from.From.GetName]'s volatile atmosphere on an industrial scale.

Using what we have learned, our [Root.Owner.GetEngineerPlural] can now greatly increase the durability of certain metals without sacrificing flexibility or adding weight.

These advanced methods can be applied to our ship construction processes.
